heard: If Betelgeuse exploded today, it would cast shadows at night. The monster star suddenly began to fade rapidly in late 2019. It plunged from top 10 brightest down past top 20. Astronomers panic because this supergiant swallows the orbit of Mars. Many feared its fatal blast was happening hundreds of years early. Hubble found the star burped a massive gas cloud that cooled into dust. When it really detonates, Earth will stay completely unharmed. Orion hides the star that will cast shadows at night.
